purpose: Reassess pre-JANUS SPEAR OF OSIRIS celestial directions using actual JANUS COSMOS radio workflow eligibility, not optical-geometric coincidences. Test authentic archive scan coverage first; only if original native spectra and pointing qualify may run frozen JANUS candidate search. Never substitute catalog photometry for radio waterfall.

coordinates_icrs_j2000.scientific_confidence: project-specified direction; not independently confirmed source
deterministic geometric construction, not an independent celestial candidate
previous Giza reflection produced no admissible optical alignment; must not silently replace canonical EDEM
not proven to belong to original SPEAR operator; separate hypothesis with prior WISE nondetection

mirror_policy.correction: All mirror directions are new look directions, not independently observed counterparts or additional data. Count all target/mirror/control trials and avoid post-hoc best-of-multiple claim.

controls.rule: For each original target check RA rotations +40 and +80 degrees preserving Dec, once only; same archive search and footprint classification. Exposure-matching not guaranteed.
controls.scientific_use: Coverage-descriptive only; not a null distribution for actual radio SNR or technosignature significance.

archive_preflight.query: SELECT TOP 100 target_name,s_ra,s_dec,t_min,t_max,obs_publisher_did,instrument_name,access_url FROM tap_schema.obscore WHERE instrument_name='GBT' AND spatial bounding box around frozen coordinate
archive_preflight.frequency_sensitive_beam: Not modelled: catalog angular separation alone does not prove target inside telescope spectral primary beam.
required_for_real_spectral_test: nonzero original per-scan pointing from authenticated raw antenna TCS or backend, not merely requested/catalog coordinates
source native waterfall (.fil/.h5) with bytes checksum and valid frequency grid/time stamps
observation band/time, matched OFF and repeat if claim concerns source origin
frozen JANUS engine/version/score threshold, all candidate traces saved
independent controls at matched instrument/band/noise and multiple testing accounting

prior_optical_result.claim: Prior optical alignment not confirmed; this new radio test is independent hypothesis.
